trust_root.release_predicate_status: derived namespace/path pending explicit v3 implementation review

rotation_contract: Introduce a new permanent policy revision only through a reviewed Tree-B or later normal PR.
Pin the exact publisher workflow commit, action commits, source ref, repository ID, predicate types, and product namespace in the new revision.
Verify a new live Main-B-equivalent binding before retiring the previous revision; retain both revisions and historical evidence during overlap.
Re-run historical verification against the immutable evidence records after each rotation.
revocation_contract: Revoke the temporary velnor-bootstrap-authority App/key only after Tree-B permanent trust and clean-checkout consumer verification pass.
Archive the temporary public-key fingerprint, verifier revision, lease, and transition evidence; never use it as a permanent B signer.
Do not remove or clean up the permanent B publisher workflow, OIDC/Sigstore policy, or its historical verification records.
historical_verification: Every retained policy revision and evidence record is addressed by SHA-256 and rechecked against the recorded signer workflow/ref, source SHA, raw ZIP digest, inner payload digest, binary digest, release target, and predicate type.
